hook: What Is It? The Bread from Heaven
text: In the morning the dew lay around the camp. When the dew had gone, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground. When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, What is it? Moses said to them, It is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat. It was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
